title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Self-Contained Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec (6,2) STNFS (de Bruijn + 4-Cap Z[omega] LA): 2^87.549287356

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the self-contained 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec content-reduced reciprocal CM-sextic tower, order-6 Frobenius tau = Frob^10, Arch B-Hybrid reversed a-table replay with pure-scalar 64-bit SWAR scan+zero and analytical Gaussian-volume-ratio Band-3 7D Fincke-Pohst coset enumeration over [2^53.5, 2^58.0), live norm-histogram-weighted full de Bruijn rho_dB and Stage B, B_f = 2^60, B_g = 2^59, excess 0.95, full un-discounted Schirokauer maps, 1-owner 3-bucket Z[omega] Block Wiedemann with deterministic 4-parameter hard-cap abort and hard-cap cost/RAM pricing at (N_sw_cap = 0.00310*U', N_l_cap = 0.00175*U', k5_cap = 11.50, tab_r_cap = 0.85, W_avg <= 201, lazy=0), and live 62-row 12D descent at B_g = 2^59 with full-range 2^66..2^213 stochastic-dominance 12D lattice verification) returns (P0, [x]Q0) with e(P0, [x]Q0) = z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 2^88.886319183 <= 2^87.549287356 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under declared heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, and H-SEP (proof.md Section 6, explicitly including H3 that production filtered outputs satisfy all four hard caps with failure <= 0.010520 from the distribution-free 4-way frozen-scale Chebyshev bound, and H5's Gamma-Poisson PGF envelope, conditional candidate independence psi^k, and adaptive nonuniform sequential collision bound <= 4.0/(li(2^59)/6) per pair). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7301852188147836087, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.985261 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.985261 is bounded by a strict additive union bound (FIX-U). All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.
